ABOUT US
Esmoriz Train Station offers, on its first floor, a comfortable and welcoming guest house.
Completely renovated, it sought to preserve the essence of typical materials of excellence, for example, cork with all its exponential. The nobility of cork will be your ally for a unique experience where you can enjoy the most diverse sensations watching the life of the trains.
The house consists of 4 bedrooms with their own private bathroom in order to preserve the privacy that each visitor can look for. However, visitors are provided with a common room and a fully equipped kitchen where they can enjoy moments of sharing life and experiences.
In this house of yours, experience all the sensations that cork, as a 100% natural raw material, can offer in terms of touch, its thermal and acoustic insulation capacity and its versatility for being antistatic and hypoallergenic.
A Cork Train Station Guest House invites you to embark on this unique experience of Portuguese life.
